name: monitor-plc
description: Desktop monitoring application for Siemens S7 PLC
author: SCMT

scripts.prod: npm run build && npx concurrently "npx serve -s dist -l 3000" "npx wait-on http://localhost:3000 && powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command Start-Process http://localhost:3000"
scripts.electron-build:win:nsis: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json --win nsis --publish=never
scripts.electron-build:win:portable: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json --win portable --publish=never
scripts.electron-build:linux:appimage: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json --linux AppImage --publish=never
scripts.electron-build:linux:deb: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json --linux deb --publish=never
